feedback.end: Butterflies like to lay eggs on plants. Once the egg is laid, it only takes 4 days to hatch.
They will only be caterpillars for about 2 weeks. In this time, caterpillars shed their skin and grow new ones 2-3 times.
Caterpillars stay in their cocoons for 8-15 days. When they come out, they will have wings and be able to fly!

This butterfly is called a monarch butterfly. They travel around 3,000 miles every year and fly around 100 miles a day. So if you see a monarch, know it’s just visiting, and you were very lucky to have met!
